title: Some users' Microsoft 365 Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot
impact: Users' Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users' Microsoft 365 Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot

User impact: Users' Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot.

Current status: We're reviewing service health telemetry to isolate the source of the impact and begin developing a mitigation strategy.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to see Copilot agents may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 10:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users' Microsoft 365 Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot

User impact: Users' Copilot agents may intermittently disappear and then reappear in Copilot.

Final status: The investigation is complete and we've determined the service is healthy. A service incident didn't actually occur. This communication will expire in 24 hours.

This is the final update for the event.
